Hello! Welcome to WhoaVerse!

The site is still in its alpha stage. /u/Atko has big plans for this place, so give it a few months, and you'll see the difference.

It is not EXACTLY the same. Hear me out.

For example, to be able to downvote comments, you need to have at least 100 comment contribution points yourself. If you delete your account, the process overwrites all your comments and submissions with keyword "deleted", wiping your entire history in a few seconds. If you delete your reddit account, everyhing you ever did there will stay in their database and be publicly visible (your comment history, your posts etc). Also, we'll be removing defaults and using categories instead.

And, of course, we have many more bugs than reddit and we lack many features reddit has, so there's that :)
